ranked_companies.timing: After market close Thursday, September 17, 2026; company-confirmed 5:30 p.m. ET call
ranked_companies.expected_driver: Diluted SOL/share and net NAV after debt
ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Short squeeze or fresh dilution/collateral stress
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Material disagreement: Lean Down / Lean Up / Neutral
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Applied existing small-cap hidden-risk and low-bar reversal rules; no new method change.
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Gross SOL value looks large relative to equity value, but debt, locked assets, extreme dilution, accounting volatility and a crowded short make the immediate reaction too two-sided for a directional edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market is likely to care more about diluted SOL per share, net asset value, collateral headroom and staking cash coverage than headline EPS; published estimate breadth is too thin for a dependable consensus bar.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Accretive SOL/share, cash-cost coverage, NAV discount compression and short covering.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Dilution, weak net NAV, collateral pressure or continued cash burn.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: September 18 options implied about a 14% move from the September 15 close; August 31 short interest was about 14.78 million shares, or 20.92% of float.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage is sparse and conflicting across public aggregators; no reliable multi-analyst revision signal was available.

excluded_high_reversal_or_weak_names.reason: Absolute consensus score is below 30, reversal risk is 71, confidence is Low, and pass disparity is material.

research_allocation_view.plain_statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

consensus_method.disparity_definition: The direction-score range divided by two, yielding a 0-100 scale; lower values indicate tighter agreement and higher values indicate wider independent-pass disagreement.
consensus_method.strongest_name_disparity: Moderate-high (38) with materially different directional calls.
consensus_method.learned_lessons_review: Existing timing-confirmation, decisive-metric, small-cap hidden-risk, low-bar reversal and disagreement rules were applied. No new method change was warranted.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: Pass A emphasized leverage, dilution and collateral sensitivity and scored Lean Down. Pass B emphasized the apparent discount to gross SOL value, lower borrowing cost and squeeze potential and scored Lean Up. Pass C treated the event as a volatile SOL/NAV update and remained Neutral.
detailed_company_sections.pass_agreement_pattern: One Lean Down, one Lean Up and one Neutral; material disagreement.
detailed_company_sections.thesis: The decisive metric is fully diluted SOL per share and net asset value after debt, locked-token liquidity and all dilutive claims.
detailed_company_sections.expectation_summary: Headline EPS is noisy because crypto fair-value marks dominate; management must show that staking income and financing changes improve per-share economics rather than merely gross token holdings.
detailed_company_sections.upside_case: More than two million SOL, lower BitGo interest expense, staking cash coverage and stable diluted shares could compress the NAV discount and force short covering.
detailed_company_sections.downside_case: A seemingly acceptable quarter can still sell off if diluted SOL per share falls, working capital stays dependent on issuance, or the 200% collateral requirement becomes the market's focus.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: High at 71. The equity can squeeze sharply on relief because roughly one-fifth of float is short, while any bullish move can reverse if investors focus on leverage, locked collateral or the history of rapid share issuance.
detailed_company_sections.sentiment_read: Retail commentary is sparse but notably promotional around the NAV-discount and squeeze narrative. It is not independently verified and was given minimal weight.
detailed_company_sections.positionining_read: UPXI traded near $1.05 with a market capitalization around $68 million during the session, while SOL traded near $101.48. Options implied roughly 14% through September 18 and short interest was about 20.9% of float, indicating substantial two-sided event risk.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_revision_read: Public estimate sources conflict and analyst breadth is too thin to support a robust revision signal.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Management reports a large accounting loss or gain tied to SOL, but the stock stays within its broad event range as net NAV and dilution disclosures offset one another.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: SOL per diluted share improves, staking covers cash costs, financing looks stable and the NAV discount narrows through a short squeeze.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Per-share treasury value erodes, financing remains dilutive, or collateral and cash-burn concerns overwhelm the lower interest rate.
detailed_company_sections.final_directional_judgment: Neutral / No Edge; the event may move materially, but the three-pass consensus does not support a reliable direction.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_priority_note: Excluded; the basket remains 100% unallocated because the score, reversal risk, disparity and confidence all fail the allocation gate.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_impact_note: Disparity of 38 materially reduced confidence and prevented the apparent NAV discount from becoming an allocation candidate.
detailed_company_sections.method_update_note: No new method change; existing small-cap hidden-risk and reversal-risk rules were applied.
